newsitem.title: SPAIN: ETA rebels target French officials - Spain media.
newsitem.headline: ETA rebels target French officials - Spain media.

text.p: The Basque separatist rebel group ETA had French Interior Minister Jean-Louis Debre on a list of possible targets found during a raid by French police, Spanish state radio and television said on Friday.
His predecessor Charles Pasqua was also on the list.
The list was found in a cache of documents French police uncovered when they arrested suspected Basque guerrilla leader Juan Luis Aguirre Lete on Tuesday.
"French police seized with the ETA leader Aguirre Lete, a list of possible ETA targets in France, among them the Interior Minister Jean-Louis Debre," Spanish television said.
Spain earlier applauded the French arrest, saying it had led directly to the dismantling of a rebel squad on Friday that had been planning attacks in the Navarre region of Spain.
ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom) has killed some 800 people in the 28 years it has been struggling for Basque independence.
